about: FAA-200 (37), (56): a special-scheme source.repository is accepted exactly when it is written with two slashes and its authority names a host and port new URL accepts. The kit is stricter than new URL in two ways, listed under stricter: a host is never percent-encoded (new URL decodes %41), and a special scheme takes exactly two slashes (new URL also reads https:github.com/o/r and https:////github.com/o/r, which no repository-match rule joins to a checkout). Held by test_fabric_service_descriptors.SourceHosts, test_provider and fabric-service-descriptors.test.mjs; the Node test also checks every special-scheme row outside stricter against new URL itself.
